#!/bin/bash

# Make test_daemon_full.sh executable
chmod +x test_daemon_full.sh

# Create test directory structure
mkdir -p /tmp/test-dir
mkdir -p /tmp/test-dir/subdir

# Create test files
touch /tmp/test-dir/file1.txt
touch /tmp/test-dir/file2.txt

# Create subdirectory files
touch /tmp/test-dir/subdir/file3.txt
touch /tmp/test-dir/subdir/file4.txt

# Verify structure
ls -R /tmp/test-dir

# Run setup script
./setup.sh

# Check if daemon started successfully
if [ -f "events.log" ]; then
    echo "Daemon setup completed successfully!"
else
    echo "Error: events.log not found"
fi

# Test file operations
echo "Testing file operations..."

# Create new file
touch /tmp/test-dir/newfile.txt

# Delete existing file
rm /tmp/test-dir/file1.txt

# Wait for 5 seconds
echo "Waiting for 5 seconds..."
sleep 5

# Check logs
echo "=== Checking events.log ==="
cat events.log

# Cleanup
rm -rf /tmp/test-dir
